Extreme heat impacts France and the United States

France is experiencing an extreme heat wave, leading to warnings about potential challenges for athletes and causing wildfires in the southern regions. The United States is also facing dangerous heat, impacting celebrations. The coverage highlights the widespread effects of high temperatures across different continents.
